'''Darth Hoth Under The Table Gone Over The Top v2.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Hoth]]
* '''Published:''' 1 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 CCT Hoth DS 2003 UnderThe.txt |Download]]

updated version

== Strategy ==

Turn 1: activation-4. Deploy Fett with his gun to the Security Tower, and then deploy the Dungeon. Use CCT to search for East Platform. Use Fett's text to pull He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter, and his gun to pull Special Delivery. If you've seen Calrissian in your reserve deck, pull him.

Turn 2: activation-6. Use Special Delivery to pull Despair and Fett's gun to pull Desilijic Tattoo. Pull DB 94 with CCT and deploy it. Deploy Calrissian to DB 94. Pull the other He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter using Fett's text. Play it and then move Fett to DB 94.

Turn 3: activation-7. Use the objective to pull the Audience Chamber and Fett's Gun to pull Desilijic Tattoo. Deploy the Audience Chamber and use its text to pull Jabba. Move Fett and Lando to the Chamber. Flip objective.

Turn 4: activation-9. Use objective to pull Scum and Fett's gun to pull Jabba's Influence. Deploy both and use the latter to pull Chall Bekan. Use his text to pull Rodian, who in turn will pull IG-88.

Rest of the game: spread and drain, battling wherever possible.

Against Profit will be a little different:

Start with Jabba and Chall Bekan using Chall's text to pull Rodian(V).

Firt turn: Pull Scum. Deploy Fett and gun for 1 (-1 from Chall, -1 from Jabba, -1 from Scum=-3). Deploy Rodian for free, use him to pull IG-88. Use Fett's gun to pull Special Delivery, which will be used to pull Despair.

Use the Security Tower's text to pull Lando, who will deploy for free to the Chamber. Use Fett's text to pull He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter.

The rest is pretty much the same.

card choices (only the more obscure):

Interrogation Array-adds to force drains

Mandalorian Armor-put it on Lando to keep him around

Defensive Fire(V)-extra shot

Take Evasive Action(V)-protection from Fallen Portal and T-47 Battle Formation

Levitation Attack(V)-gets Interrogation Array and Binders from my starting effect

Thanks for looking, and, hopefully, reviewing.
